definitions.gloss: artistic style, creative style, style of work
definitions.explanation: The distinctive manner or approach characteristic of a particular artist, writer, filmmaker, or other creative person. Refers to the consistent qualities that define their body of work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧な{作風|さくふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Known for a distinctive artistic style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作風|さくふう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧きた。
examples.english: His creative style has changed over the years.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}{監督|かんとく}→映画監督：07093_eigakantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作風|さくふう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暗|くら}くて→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This film director's style tends toward dark and heavy themes.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work, creation) + {風|ふう} (style, manner). The suffix {風|ふう} appears in many style-related words: ⟦{画風|がふう}→画風：20603_gafuu⟧ (painting style), ⟦{芸風|げいふう}→芸風：15160_geifuu⟧ (performance style), ⟦{社風|しゃふう}→社風：29429_shafuu⟧ (company culture).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧な{作風|さくふう} (distinctive style)
- {作風|さくふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (style changes)
- ～⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な{作風|さくふう} (~-style creative approach)
- {作風|さくふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確立|かくりつ}→確立：13758_kakuritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to establish one's style)
